digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM structured output and Pydantic AI integration
propositions: Existing deterministic repair, schema extraction, and sentinel selection from structured.parse_structured and structured.check_response must be exposed through a Pydantic output-policy adapter without introducing new retry loops or provider selection logic

A new TextOutputFunc adapter in pai_output.py must call parse_structured for deterministic tolerant parsing and raise ModelRetry wrapping StructuredOutputError to delegate bounded retry to Pydantic AI while preserving the original Rebar error in the exception cause chain

An after_model_request capability hook must implement the stop/refusal safety guard by calling structured.check_response on the full ModelResponse, raising terminal UnretryableOutputError for refusals (preventing Pydantic retry) and retryable StructuredOutputError for transient errors
The adapter must preserve byte-for-byte parser behavior and run the safety guard before output function processing to match the current guard-before-parse ordering

Real Pydantic Agent contract tests must verify valid responses produce typed objects, repairable responses match historical deterministic selection, invalid-then-valid sequences drive Pydantic bounded retry with preserved Rebar errors in the cause chain, and refusal responses abort after one model call without retry prompts
